problem_statement: OpenThread needs a public API that takes an otOperationalDatasetTlvs and reports whether it is a well-formed Active or Pending dataset. A caller should be able to determine, given a TLV-encoded dataset, whether it is a valid Active Dataset (containing all required TLVs such as Active Timestamp, Channel, Channel Mask, Extended PAN ID, Mesh-Local Prefix, Network Key, Network Name, PAN ID, PSKc, and Security Policy, with no duplicated or malformed TLVs), or a valid Pending Dataset (an Active Dataset plus Pending Timestamp and Delay Timer). The API must return true for a freshly created, complete dataset; false when a required field is missing; false when a TLV is duplicated; and false when a pending dataset is missing its required pending fields.
